name: campus-laundry
description: Students Campus Laundry Booking and Management System: book washers and dryers, notifications, laundry tips and feedback. Node.js + Express + MySQL.

scripts.test: node tools/compare-schema.js && node tools/test-constraints.js && node tools/test-api.js && node tools/test-ui.js && node tools/test-load.js
scripts.docs:requirements: node tools/erd.js && node docs/build/build-requirements.js && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File docs/build/word-finalise.ps1 -Docx docs/Laundry-Requirements.docx
scripts.docs:manual: node docs/build/build-manual.js && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File docs/build/word-finalise.ps1 -Docx docs/Laundry-User-Manual.docx
scripts.docs:test-report: node docs/build/build-test-report.js && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File docs/build/word-finalise.ps1 -Docx docs/Laundry-Test-Report.docx
